_comment: Cast list. Each person has a list of 'parts'. 'track' must be one of: Castle, Storybook, Both, TBD. Use Both for a role played in both weekends.
heading: Cast List
intro: Thank you for auditioning! We are very sad to say goodbye to 17 friends. If it were at all possible to have that many kids on stage, we would have made it happen. Cutoff was determined by time of registration, not exclusively by talent. We wish we could keep everyone. They all did such a great job!

With so many talented performers, we are delighted to announce double casting for the roles of: Shrek, Fiona (human, ogre, teen and young), Donkey, Farquaad, and Dragon. We have one cast - everyone performs both weekends - with the Castle Track taking the leads April 15-16, 2027 and the Storybook Track taking the leads April 22-23, 2027.
By order of Lord Farquaad, the cast list is as follows:

characters._comment: Meet the characters, at the bottom of the Cast page. Each group is a heading and the roles under it, in order, spelled as on the Cast tab. Roles with the same description share one card, and the roles in each of 'cards' share one card under that name. A role not listed here goes under its students' group on the Scenes tab. 'icons' gives each card its emoji, by the card's name as it shows on the page; a card without one gets 🎭. Roles in 'skip' are not characters and are left out.
